activated-stream run-ahead in the down phase: row cores grant an activated ring slot (ack its sender) as soon as it is free and senders multicast as soon as all grants are in, with per-slot valid flags and an activated ring of up to 4 slots from leftover L1 (on r04-b02-a01's reader)
